itemdesc-vigilfocus: Paired brass forearm bracers with responsive verdant shards. Wear them in the Arm equipment slot to channel flight.
focus-empty: The bracers have no resonance left. Return them to a Resonance Vessel.
focus-no-target: The focus needs a solid point of reference.
focus-obstructed: The resonant form is obstructed or protected.
focus-placement-failed: The resonant form collapsed before it could stabilize.
flight-depleted: The focus has exhausted its resonance and flight has ended.
flight-focus-required: Equip charged Vigil Bracers in the Arm slot to fly.
flight-unavailable: The focus cannot stabilize flight right now.
vessel-recharged: The Resonance Vessel restores the focus to {0} resonance.
vessel-already-charged: The focus is already fully resonant.
sense-result: Verdant Sense reveals {0} nearby Resonance Vessel(s).
recall-no-vessel: No Resonance Vessel answers within range.
recall-used: A Resonance Vessel answers the recall: +{0}% resonance.
ward-used: The bracers flare, turning aside the worst of the blow.
